newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland cuts min price of 10-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: Poland cuts min price of 10-yr bonds.

text.p: Poland cut the minimum price of the 10-year floating bond by 0.10 point to 99.60 at Tuesday's tender, for which demand was 122.5 million zlotys against a one billion offer, the finance ministry said on Wednesday.
The average price fell 0.21 point to 99.73 since the last auction of the bonds, maturing July 18, 2006, last month.
The ministry accepted 91.5 million zlotys worth of bids.
